image_description: A medium shot of two individuals outdoors on a paved street with buildings in the background. The primary subject is a woman on the right wearing a purple and black academic gown with wide sleeves and a black mortarboard cap. She is smiling at the camera. To her left, a man walks away from the camera, wearing a white and black academic gown with text on the back and a similar cap. In the background, there is a building with yellow facade, green grass, and other pedestrians.
